p: Next, a contact sheet: ONE square image divided into a 2 x 2 grid of four equal square panels with thin plain gaps between them. Each panel is a separate studio product photo in exactly the master style (same warm grey backdrop, same lighting, same three-quarter front-left angle, object filling about 80% of its panel, matte black finish unless stated, unbranded, no text, no people). Top left: An EZ curl bar, a short 1.2 m chrome bar with a zig-zag W-shaped centre section offering angled grips, with short plain sleeves at each end loaded with a small plate on each side and spring collars. Top right: A triceps / hammer curl bar, a short bar formed into an open rectangular frame with two parallel neutral grip handles running across the inside, with short loading sleeves at each end. Bottom left: A trap / hex bar, a hexagonal steel frame bar that the lifter stands inside, with two parallel knurled handles on opposite sides of the hexagon, raised high handles as an option, and long loading sleeves protruding from each end. Bottom right: A swiss / football bar, a barbell built as a long open ladder frame, with several pairs of neutral grip handles running crossways between two parallel rails, some angled, and standard loading sleeves at each end.

Top left: A half rack / squat stands, a pair of tall upright steel posts on a rectangular base with J-hooks holding a barbell, short spotter arms projecting forwards and a pull-up bar connecting the tops, open at the front. Top right: A monolift, a heavy two-post squat stand with hooks on swinging arms that hold the bar then pivot out of the way, a foot-operated lever cam at the base and long safety arms projecting forward. Bottom left: A functional training rig, a long run of connected steel uprights and crossbeams forming several squat bays, with multiple pull-up bars at different heights, monkey bar rungs across the top, J-hooks on the uprights and hanging gymnastic rings. Bottom right: A home multi-gym, a single-stack steel home gym with a central weight stack, a padded seat with a chest press arm, a high pulley with lat bar, a low pulley at the front and a leg extension and curl roller pad at the base of the seat.

Top left: A seal row bench, a long flat padded bench raised on tall legs to about waist height, with a step and a pair of bar catches underneath so the user can lie face down and row a barbell or dumbbells up to the pad. Top right: A hip thrust bench, a low padded back support bench at knee height, with a curved pad for the upper back, a floor base the user sits on, and band pegs or a barbell resting across the hips area. Bottom left: A deadlift platform, a large square wooden centre panel flanked on both sides by thick black rubber mats, raised slightly above the floor, with a loaded barbell resting on the rubber sections. Bottom right: A set of pulling / jerk blocks, a pair of stacked wooden or foam cubes of adjustable height, placed under each end of a loaded barbell so the bar sits off the floor at knee height.

Top left: A high pulley, a single upright steel tower with a weight stack in a guarded frame and one pulley mounted at the top, the cable hanging down with a straight bar attached. Top right: An adjustable pulley (any height), a single tall steel tower with a weight stack and a pulley carriage that slides up and down a vertical rail with a pop-pin to set any height, a D-handle clipped to the cable. Bottom left: A low pulley, a cable station with a pulley fixed just above floor level at the base of a weight stack tower, with the cable running out horizontally to a handle on the floor. Bottom right: A seated cable row, a long low padded bench running away from a weight stack, with an angled footplate at the stack end and a cable emerging from a pulley at foot height with a close-grip V handle.

Top right: A lat bar, a long chrome bar about 120 cm wide with ends bent downwards and outwards and rubber grips, with a central swivel clip ring. Bottom left: A MAG grip / multi-grip handles, a set of row and pulldown handles with a cast aluminium frame in a long U shape, with parallel neutral or pronated grips set at different widths and a clip ring in the centre. Bottom right: An ankle strap, a padded neoprene cuff with a hook-and-loop fastening and a metal D ring sewn on, designed to wrap around the ankle and clip to a low cable.

Bottom left: A curved / self-powered treadmill, a non-motorised treadmill with a concave curved slatted running surface that dips in the middle, and handles at the front. Bottom right: A stair climber, a tall motorised machine with a revolving staircase of steps that rotate downwards like an escalator, side handrails and a console at chest height.
